title: All the functions you really need and no any trash
body: Sooo stylish and not really disturbing app. I like it! I’ve tried half of all the App Store habit-tracker apps, and this is the prettiest one. I truly recommend it!
author: AnnKaval

title: It's not worth it.
body: I don't understand why there is a subscription here. The app itself has a maximum price of $13 one-time. For what reason did you decide that your app, which has no serious functionality, should have a subscription. 1 star because of the subscription.
author: Недовольный Олегушка
